caption: The drawing depicts a single shoe positioned with its left side facing the viewer. The shoe is primarily gray with a textured appearance and has a closed, square-shaped toe. The interior of the shoe is a light tan color. A prominent feature is the strap across the instep, secured with a large, rectangular buckle that appears metallic and is framed by a yellow-brown border. The shoe’s low, square heel is colored a muted reddish-pink, contrasting with the gray upper. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a small, handwritten signature in the lower left that reads “DOROTHY DWYN-1941.” No other objects or details are present in the composition.
title: Man's Shoe
